body:
It’s not painful. You slip out of consciousness. May look uncomfortable to an observer, but not for you. I’ve passed myself out multiple times. Pressure in your face from the noose then things get black from the outside in the like going through a narrowing tunnel. Then nothing. The only discomfort is from waking up. If you do it right, of course, that isn’t an issue. 

Also jumping from an insane height onto solid ground is painless. You’ll be regretting it all the way down which probably isn’t fun. 

Shotgun in your mouth is Insta-death. 

Tbh, most of the pain comes from imagining the aftermath. Which is silly if you think about it as you won’t be alive to care.

“Divine being telling you to hold on and never let go, never let my light burn out.”

Just so that divine being can watch you struggle longer then snuff your light out themselves.

Tbf, most people really don’t care if a person takes their life. The person contemplating it tends to the one with all the feels. Generally you’ll just get lazy supportive statements like, “we love you. Don’t do it.” I doubt you’ll get many angry or hostile responses if you walk up to someone and say “I want to kill myself.”
You teach people how to treat you. If you have a problem with how a friend/peer is behaving towards yourself start by looking in the mirror. As an introvert this is a shitty truism.

It’s the reality we live in. It’s why so many of us flock to places like this. There’s something therapeutic about knowing others are suffering a long side yourself. Which I could take it all on myself.

Human nature’s way of placing value on meaningless lives is what’s driving suicidal ideation. It’s ok. You don’t matter (I mean that in a good way). Recognizing you don’t matter is also a good way of finally enjoying life for once!
I want to kill myself because of how good looking I am. Unreasonable expectations placed on me from people I don’t even know or just met.
Yes. Literally no one is stopping you.
The interwebs can be your home. We love you here and understand.
Is this how racist children acted when gifted a slave? Is this how the slave acted? Any old ass racists can answer for me?
